extracted.name: Roux (Cajun style)
extracted.description: Roux is the foundation of a lot of Cajun recipes. Gumbo being the most famous 😋 All it takes is 2 ingredients and lots of time.
ingredient_lines: Large heavy bottom pot. (cast iron or a Magnalite aluminum pot)
instruction_lines: Pot should be big enough to safely stir it! Roux is HOT and will burn the heck out of you so be very careful!!! We're using equal parts oil and flour. If you plan on making lots of Cajun food I recommend making extra and storing it. It doesn't take any more time to make a big batch and it will keep indefinitely.
Put your heavy bottom pot over high heat.
Add 1-4 cups vegetable oil (I make extra and store it in glass jars)
When oil is hot add 1-4 cups flour. *(Remember, we're using equal parts oil and flour!)
I usually turn the heat down to medium high after I add the flour.
Start stirring... you're going to be here for a looooong time. Seriously, this takes about an hour...of stirring... CONSTANTLY 🥵
Starting to get some color, about 25 minutes in ("blond" roux)
Another 15 minutes to get here (light brown roux) nice, but not there yet.
Finally! (Feel like my arm is gonna fall off 🙃) Dark Roux! ❤️ Totally worth it!
